title: HEARTS: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning on Health Time Series
description: HEARTS benchmarks code-using language-model agents across diverse physiological time-series tasks and finds that strong general reasoning scores do not reliably translate into accurate, data-grounded temporal analysis. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Sirui Li et al., arXiv:2603.06638v3 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06638v3
